generations.prompt: Night on the stone balcony; the camera is locked off, level with the two of them in a medium two-shot: the young man in the wine-red doublet stands just inside the balustrade, a little out of breath, one hand still on the rail, facing the young woman in the pale gold gown, who faces him a step away with the white earbud still in her left ear; the arched doorway with the sheer curtain and candlelight behind them; vertical frame. She takes the earbud out of her ear and holds it. He says exactly one word: "Hi." She says exactly one word: "Hi." They both smile. Nothing else is said. Exactly two people; nobody else appears. The camera does not move. Sound: the two words clearly, crickets, a breeze in the curtain; no music. No on-screen text, no captions, no lettering anywhere.
